title: New York Times DealBook: Eric on the financial system that pulls organizations toward extraction
summary: Sarah Kessler interviews Eric for The New York Times' DealBook newsletter, framing the book inside a piece on the macroeconomic backdrop of U.S. debt reaching 100% of GDP. Eric's core line: the financial system has a gravitational pull toward mediocrity that organizations must be designed to resist.
blockquote: We built this financial system that has this gravitational pull down into mediocrity and to extraction and exploitation. You can imagine building a different financial system, but until we get there, my goal is simply to have people be able to build organizations that can resist that.
blockquote_source: Sarah Kessler in NYT DealBook (quoting Eric Ries)
